Welcome to
Clark County, Missouri
Welcome to the official website of the Clark County Courthouse & Government.
On this site, you will find information including departmental listings, contact information, and many additional resources. In Clark County, we strive to provide more effective and efficient local government services to our citizens. This newly designed website is just a part of our overall effort to continue providing responsive government to the public. We strive to make this website a place where citizens can conduct business and perform research from the comfort of their own homes or offices. This expands our citizens' access to county services beyond regular office hours.
Please feel free to visit often and enjoy your online stay. We also welcome you to visit us in person and experience Clark County for yourself.
